Check out the schedules, standings and results of your favourite (e)sports tournaments and leagues in the Tournify app. Follow a team or player and never miss a match anymore.

Our iPhone app is made especially for participants and spectators. Do you organise a tournament yourself? Please go to www.tournifyapp.com and create your own tournament schedule in minutes. 

These are the key features of the app:
- Discover tournaments and leagues
- Follow your favourite team or player to get your personalised match schedule
- Receive push notifications for upcoming matches, schedule changes, new results or tournament updates
- Check out all up to date group standings, swipe through bracket rounds and proceed to the final
- Enter scores of your own matches if you received a personal login link from the organisation
- Use your personal login link to check in beforehand if you participate in an online esports tournament

The Tournify app is available in Dutch, English, Spanish, German, Polish and French and has both a day and night mode.
